definition: Dream ego is the dreamer’s sense of self as it appears within a dream narrative. In this research, it is described through features such as how much agency the dream self has, how clearly it is defined or vague, how freely it moves, and how it relates to other people in the dream.

reasons: The packet supports dream-ego as a feature of dream structure characterized by agency, mobility, vagueness, and the presence of others, but it does not define it as the dreamer’s “sense of self” within the dream narrative.
The definition adds “how freely it moves,” which is only loosely related to the packet’s phrase “clear mobility” and is not stated as a definitional feature in the source.
The wording presents these features as a current general definition rather than as findings from previous research in this specific article context.

The packet does not explicitly define “dream ego” as the “dreamer’s sense of self,” nor does it provide wording that directly supports the specific characterization “sense of self as it appears within a dream narrative.” It only reports comparisons in terms of “dream-ego agency,” “vagueness of the dream-ego,” “mobility,” and “presence of others,” without defining the construct in those terms.
